note: Curated first-run plugin list. Phase 1 installs the bootstrap entry (dshmarket) directly before the server boots; phase 2 installs the rest through the market's own install API (url = curated-registry entry URL; versions follow the market: npm latest / GitHub HEAD). If the market API is unreachable or lacks an entry, that entry falls back to a direct `dsh plugin add` using spec. After provisioning they are ordinary plugins managed by dshmarket. dsh-startup-guard is included since 1.0.0: it is npm-published (dsh-startup-guard@1.0.0) so every user gets the boot-time guard (session repair, composition preflight, crash quarantine).

plugins.name: dshmarket
plugins.reason: plugin ecosystem entry; must exist before the server boots
